Which is the Best Chocolate in the Indian Market? 20 Chocolates in India Ranked from Worst to Best.

This video is powered by Olena. 

Did you know that chocolate is good for you ? Yes, The main ingredient used to make chocolate, cocoa, is known to have numerous health benefits. However, most chocolates available in the market hardly have any cocoa in them and are no less than chocolate colored sugar candies. Forget about health benefits, the harmful effects of eating these chocolates are many. So, is healthy chocolate a dream or reality? Well, watch this video till the end as I have found out the healthiest and the cheapest chocolate that you must try out this season.

In this video, I have Ranked 20 Most commonly eaten Chocolates in India from Worst to Best. 

00:50 - CATEGORY #1 - These are chocolate colored sugar candies. They have only 5-7% cocoa in them. The amount of sugar in just one bar is 6-7 tsps. On top of it, they have any unwanted fillers.

01:25 - CATEGORY #2 - These are so called dark chocolates. Definitely, the percentage of cocoa is higher but the sugar is also no less. They also have some unwanted fillers.

01:42 - CATEGORY #3 - These are definitely the best chocolates in the Indian market. Not only they have over 70% of cocoa but also have almost no sugar. These, however, are pricey as most of them are imported.

METHOD OF PREPARATION

Add 1/4 cup of cold pressed coconut oil in a cold saucepan. Immediately add 4 tbsp of honey. Whisk it for about 10 seconds just to get the honey mixed. The glossy mixture formed should neither be runny nor thick, just the pouring consistency. Pour it in your favorite mould or any container and refrigerate for a few hours. That's all. metadata.original_title: STOP Buying Greek Yogurt! Make Thick Creamy Yogurt at Home (Only 2 Ingredients 😳)
metadata.clean_title: STOP Buying Greek Yogurt Make Thick Creamy Yogurt at Home (Only 2 Ingredients 😳)
metadata.description:
Learn how to make thick and creamy Greek yogurt at home using only two simple ingredients! In this tutorial, I'll show you my fail-proof method for achieving that perfect store-bought texture without any expensive equipment or a yogurt maker. This homemade yogurt is healthy, probiotic-rich, and much more affordable than the Greek yogurt you find in stores.
🥛 Ingredients:
Milk (Whole milk works best for extra creaminess)
Yogurt Starter (Plain yogurt with live active cultures)
What you'll learn in this video:
The best temperature for heating milk.
How to simmer milk to concentrate proteins for thickness.
Tips for incubating your yogurt in a warm place (like an oven).
How to strain your yogurt for that authentic Greek texture.

If you enjoyed this recipe, don't forget to LIKE and SUBSCRIBE to My Lockdown Rasoi for more easy, healthy, and budget-friendly recipes!

#GreekYogurt #HomemadeYogurt #HealthyRecipes #DIYCooking #2Ingredients #MyLockdownRasoi  #CookingAtHome #YogurtRecipe

3. Timestamps
0:00 - The Secret to Thick Greek Yogurt at Home
0:24 - Step 1: Prepare Thick Starter
0:43 - Step 2: Boil the Milk
1:22 - Step 3: Simmer the Milk
2:04 - Step 4: Cool the Milk
2:33 - Step 5: Prepare the Starter Mixture
3:06 - Step 6: Set the Yogurt
3:35 - Step 7: Refrigerate for Thick Yogurt
4:14 - Step 7: Making Greek Yogurt
---
Join this channel to get access to perks:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCZAc6j2gnLgbVtvZ9F_biQg/join
---

segments.text: [00:00:00] Homemade Greek Yogurt STOP buying Greek yogurt in plastic tubs! 😳 Make Thick & Creamy High-Protein Yogurt [00:00:16] No preservatives • Just 2 simple ingredients. Perfect Greek Yogurt with All Tips & Tricks ✨ Step 1: Prepare Thick Starter Plain yogurt (as a starter) - 1/2 Cup [00:00:32] Pour it in a strainer Let it strain until all the extra water drains out. Step 2: Boil the Milk Full Cream Milk - 4 Cup (1L) [00:00:55] I was wondering where are you watching us from ! Write in the comment, So I can thank you all 😊 Heat it over medium heat Stir occasionally [00:01:11] Stir to prevent scorching and burning let it come to a boil. Step 3: Simmer the Milk lower the flame and let it simmer for 15 minutes. [00:01:34] This step changes the proteins in the milk to create a thicker texture Note : Don’t skip this simmering step [00:01:50] After 15 minutes Switch off the flame Transfer the milk to a bowl. Step 4: Cool the Milk [00:02:06] let the milk cool until it is just warm to the touch, Check the milk temperature with a thermometer. Ideal temperature for setting yogurt: 43–45°C. [00:02:22] If you don’t have a thermometer, dip finger into the milk. If you can hold it comfortably for 5–10 seconds, the temperature is perfect. Step 5: Prepare the Starter Mixture The water from the curd will be fully drained. [00:02:42] Transfer the thick curd to a bowl whisk until smooth. Whisk otherwise the Greek yogurt may turn lumpy. Take about 1 cup of the warm milk. Add 1/2 cup lukewarm milk to the yogurt at a time and mix well. [00:03:03] Add the remaining 1/2 cup warm milk Step 6: Set the Yogurt Add the prepared curd mixture into the lukewarm milk Important Note : While Adding Yogurt If the milk is too hot, it will kill the starter cultures; if it is too cold, the bacteria won't multiply [00:03:22] Cover the bowl with a lid Place the pot in a warm place Leave it undisturbed for 8 to 12 hours to set. After 8 hours Step 7: Refrigerate for Thick Yogurt [00:03:38] Once the yogurt is fully set place it in the refrigerator. Chilling helps the yogurt become thicker and creamier. Perfect Homemade Thick Yogurt [00:03:58] Look at this thicker creamier homemade yogurt Delicious Yogurt with just 2 simple ingredients! [00:04:15] Step 7: Making Greek Yogurt Place a muslin cloth over a strainer Pour the prepared yogurt onto the cloth. [00:04:34] wrap it properly Place it into the refrigerator. Let it strain for an hour After 1 hour [00:04:50] thick yogurt The liquid that drains to the bottom is whey save it for smoothies or baking whisk until smooth [00:05:16] Perfect Homemade Greek yogurt Thick, Creamy, Protein Rich and Delicious! Store the Greek yogurt in a clean airtight jar It will stay fresh for about 7 to 10 days [00:05:34] Thanks for watching

Boil it down to 750 ml with stirring.
Cool it to luke warm to the touch
Add a heaped teaspoon of hung yogurt well beaten
Place in a warm place for 8-12 hours depending on your local temperature.
You can add sugar or sweetner to taste before you add the beaten yogurt.
A few strands of Saffron at the boiling stage does wonders.
Fruit pulp and or small bits of fruit make it exotic.
1/2 tea spoon of yogurt is more than enough for 1 kg milk to turn into curd .
Hung curd and Greek yogurt are very similar, but they're not exactly the same.

Greek yogurt is also strained, but it starts with yogurt made using specific yogurt cultures rather than traditional dahi culture. Greek yogurt is usually made under controlled conditions.Strained to remove more whey than regular yogurt.Often contains more protein than homemade hung curd. It has a smoother, creamier texture.

Yoghurt culture has two components. Lactobacillus bulgaris and Streptococcus thermophilus. Curd is made from only Lactobacillus bulgaris. That is the reason Yoghurt is a lot costlier than curd. So what you have shown is just Curd. The culture of yoghurt is very costly. It is nearly Rs. 10.00 per gram.

Thanks for sharing your knowledge. 😊 However, curd (dahi) is not made from only one bacterium and contains a variety of beneficial cultures. In this video, I've shown a homemade Greek-style yogurt method by straining fresh curd to achieve a thick, creamy texture. The focus is on creating a similar product at home using easily available ingredients. Also, the higher price of commercial yogurt is due to standardized cultures, processing, packaging, and branding—not just the cost of the culture itself.

segments.text: [00:00:00] Are you a late night snacker? Is your work not letting you to sleep early. Or perhaps you are a student preparing for an upcoming examination. Or the Soccer World cup is keeping you up late at nights. Well, whatever your reasons are, late night snacks should be chosen very carefully else [00:00:16] it can sabotage your weight loss effort and instantly put you off the fitness track. So, what are the healthiest snacks to munch on late at night? Let us find out. Hello Friends! Welcome to Fit Tuber. For this video, I have identified the foods most commonly eaten by us late at night and [00:00:37] have ranked them from worst to best. After taking into consideration various factors like how fast they get digested in the body, their nutritional value etc. I have categorised them in two categories, the worst and the best. Category#1 includes the foods which we have been used to eating late at nights. [00:00:56] It includes Biscuits, Namkeen, Kurkure, Lay's, Maggi, Chocolates and whatever else catches the eye. If you are even slightly serious about your fitness goals, these are the food items you should not even touch late in the night. [00:01:11] Most of these are simple form of carbohydrates deep fried in oil. At night, our body is not physically active and most of these carbohydrates remain unutilized and are ultimately get stored in the form of fat. Whereas Lay's, Kurkure and other namkeen items are extremely high in sodium, on the other [00:01:29] hand Biscuits, Chocolates and sweets are mostly sugar and maida. These food items are anyway unhealthy but consuming them late at night may prove disastrous for you. Eating any of these late in the night will make you put on extra weight, feel bloated and you will end up repenting in the morning. [00:01:47] So, are there any guilt free options to snack on late at night? YES. Category #2 includes the best late night snack options. Starting with one of my favourites is Homemade Popcorn. Take 1/4th cup of Popcorn kernels and put them in a cooker. [00:02:03] Cover the cooker with a lid or a plate. let the flame be on the lowest. The corn will start popping up in no time. One bill bowl of homemade popcorn has only 70 calories. It is tasty and filling at the same time. Avoid making ACT II popcorn which is 5 times higher in calories loaded with saturated fats [00:02:21] and sodium. Phool Makhane or Lotus seeds is another low calorie, low glycemic, light and crunchy snack option ideal for late night munching. One bowl of dry roasted Phool Makhane has only 90 calories, 18 grams of carbohydrates [00:02:37] and 3 grams of protein. One more option which is widely used in the Indian subcontinent is Puffed Rice. One cup of puffed rice has only 56 calories. Since, it is so low in calories one can easily consume a big bowl of puffed rice at night [00:02:52] and still stay strong on the weight loss journey. One handful of unsalted dry roasted peanuts is another crunchy and healthy snack option to be consumed at night. Taking my attention away from the crunchy snacks is another delicious and healthy night [00:03:07] snack option, Chocolate Milk. In one glass of toned milk, hot or cold, add 1 teaspoon of natural unsweetened cocoa powder. You may sweeten it with 1 teaspoon of honey. A complete meal in itself, an excellent source of slow digesting Casein protein, milk is [00:03:24] ideal before bed. You can even have 1 bar of homemade dark chocolate with one glass of milk as a healthy late night snack option. Another milk based option is Oatmeal. 1/4th cup of oats in 1 glass of hot milk will not only fill up your tummy but is also among the healthier late night snack options. [00:03:44] This snack option will provide you about 180 calories. The final late night snack option that I have for you is Peanut Butter Roti. Apply 1 tablespoon of natural peanut butter over a medium sized whole wheat chapati. Roll it and have it. Quick and healthy, this filling snack option is under 180 calories. [00:04:04] Make sure that you use a natural peanut butter. One good option that I highly recommend is Alpino's peanut butter. Alpino's peanut butter is truly a butter for better health as it devoid of added sugar, hydrogenated oils or unwanted additives. [00:04:20] The ingredient list speaks for itself, ROASTED PEANUTS (100%). One serving of Alpino's peanut butter will give you 10 grams of protein, 15 grams of healthy fats and 7 grams of carbohydrates. Peanut butter by Alpino comes in both the variants, Creamy as well as Crunchy. [00:04:38] You can apply it on whole wheat chapati, blend it into smoothies, stir it in to oatmeal and more. Alpino's peanut butter is a healthy and a delicious way to fulfil your late night food cravings. You can use this peanut butter without refrigeration for over 9 months. [00:04:54] Buy Alpino's peanut butter by clicking on the link down in the description box. So, I hope this video helped you identify the low calorie, healthy, crunchy, light and filling options for late night snacking. Although, late night snacking isn't highly recommended but if your work demands so or [00:05:11] you are actually feeling very hungry these snacks should be your go to options. Much better than the usual unhealthy snacks we mindlessly munch on. It is also recommended that you drink a glass of water and wait for 15-20 minutes to check whether you are really hungry or just dehydrated. [00:05:28] So Friends! That's all for this video. I hope you found it to be helpful. If yes, then please let me know by giving this video a big thumbs up. Which late night snack option did you like the most? Let me know in the comment section. Please do remember to SUBSCRIBE to my channel. Hit that BELL ICON so that you never miss a video from me. [00:05:46] My name is Vivek, I THANK YOU so much for watching.
